info.title: API.SH: Metrocuadrado
info.description: The Metrocuadrado API from API.SH: public Metrocuadrado data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Metrocuadrado listing: title, type, deal, sale or rent price in COP, admin fee, areas, rooms, bathrooms, parking, stratum, condition, category, project, city, zone, neighborhood, coordinates, description, every listed feature (parking type, amenities, nearby services, floor, age), advertiser (type, agency id, and the agency's or builder's phone and WhatsApp), contacts received, all photos and nearby places. Private owners' name, phone and WhatsApp are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search params to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/metrocuadrado-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first result of a search made with the other params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. city, deal), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Apartamento en Arriendo, CHAPINERO MARLY   Zona Urbana, Bogotá D.C.
example.description: Con excelente transporte, cerca a centros educativos, comerciales y recreativos.

get.summary: Metrocuadrado homes for sale and rent
get.description:
Colombian homes and commercial property for sale or rent on Metrocuadrado by property type, city and neighborhood, with rooms, bathrooms, parking spaces, stratum, area, price, keywords, agency and sort. Each result has id, link, title, type, deal, sale or rent price in COP, admin fee, areas, rooms, bathrooms, parking, stratum, condition, project, city, zone, neighborhood, coordinates, description, features, advertiser (type, agency id, and the agency's or builder's phone and WhatsApp), photos and nearby places; `featured` holds the site's highlighted listings. Listings by private owners come without the owner's name, phone or WhatsApp. 50 per page (up to 10,000 results); pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/metrocuadrado-search

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description: venta (for sale, default) or arriendo (for rent).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, e.g. bogota, medellin, cali, barranquilla (default bogota).

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Neighborhood or zone within the city, e.g. chapinero.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words to look for in listings.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Only listings of one agency (its number, from a listing's advertiser.company_id).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
